name: An Infinite Highway
desc:
Journey across the continent in an expedition group whose goal is to survey and explore dangerous territory.

You will ride from pole-to-pole, crossing through various biomes, whether it be:
--Tropical savannas teeming with wildlife
--Dry deserts, baked by the hot scorching sun
--Valleys with goats and cattle in between the tall mountains
--Cold, icey polar regions, where the sun dances around

Becareful however, as bandits fill the area, raiding settlements, disrupting trade routes, and waging conflict with government forces.

this script can give you any gears using gear ids and its serversided using a vulnerability

(MADE WITH THE USE OF AI)
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

local guiParent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
pcall(function() if gethui then guiParent = gethui() end end)
for _, g in ipairs(guiParent:GetChildren()) do
	if g.Name == "GearGiverGui" then g:Destroy() end
end

local function findGearRemote()
	for _, d in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("RemoteFunction") and d.Name == "RemoteFunction" then
			if d:FindFirstAncestor("gear machine chest") then return d end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Name = "GearGiverGui"
screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
screen.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screen.DisplayOrder = 999
screen.Parent = guiParent

main.BorderSizePixel = 0

Instance.new("UICorner", main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")

title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 1, 0)

closeBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 70)

closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TS:Create(closeBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 70), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 215)}):Play() end)

local modeBar = Instance.new("Frame")
modeBar.Name = "ModeBar"
modeBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 44)
modeBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 28)
modeBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 38)
modeBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
modeBar.ZIndex = 2
modeBar.Parent = main
Instance.new("UICorner", modeBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)

local function makeModeBtn(name, text, xscale)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Name = name
	b.Position = UDim2.new(xscale, 0, 0, 0)
	b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, -6)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(124, 92, 255)
	b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.AutoButtonColor = false
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.Text = text
	b.TextSize = 12
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 175)
	b.ZIndex = 3
	b.Parent = modeBar
	Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
	return b
end

local btnSingle = makeModeBtn("Single", "SINGLE", 0)
btnSingle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
local btnMulti = makeModeBtn("Multi", "MULTIPLE", 0.5)
btnMulti.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 1, 0, 3)

local function makeBox()
	local b = Instance.new("TextBox")
	b.Name = "GearBox"
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 44)
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	b.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 145)
	b.Text = ""
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)
	b.TextSize = 13
	b.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	b.ZIndex = 2
	b.Parent = main
	Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Thickness = 1; s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 100); s.Transparency = 0.3; s.Parent = b
	local p = Instance.new("UIPadding"); p.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8); p.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8); p.Parent = b
	b.Focused:Connect(function() TS:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(124, 92, 255), Transparency = 0}):Play() end)
	b.FocusLost:Connect(function() TS:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 100), Transparency = 0.3}):Play() end)
	return b
end

local tb1 = makeBox()
local tb2 = makeBox()
local tb3 = makeBox()
local tb4 = makeBox()
local boxes = {tb1, tb2, tb3, tb4}

local giveBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
giveBtn.Name = "GiveButton"
giveBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 38)
giveBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(124, 92, 255)
giveBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
giveBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
giveBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
giveBtn.Text = "GIVE GEAR"
giveBtn.TextSize = 15
giveBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
giveBtn.ZIndex = 2
giveBtn.Parent = main
Instance.new("UICorner", giveBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
local gGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
gGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(139, 108, 255), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248))
gGrad.Parent = giveBtn
local gStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); gStroke.Thickness = 1; gStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 165, 255); gStroke.Transparency = 0.5; gStroke.Parent = giveBtn
giveBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TS:Create(giveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 38)}):Play() end)
giveBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TS:Create(giveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 38)}):Play() end)

local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
status.Name = "Status"
status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24)
status.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
status.TextSize = 12
status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 165)
status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
status.ZIndex = 2
status.Parent = main

local function setStatus(msg, color)
	status.Text = msg
	status.TextColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 165)
end

local mode = "single"
local halfW = (W - 24 - 8) / 2

local function setMode(newMode)
	mode = newMode
	local isMulti = newMode == "multi"

	if isMulti then
		tb1.PlaceholderText = "Gear ID 1"
		tb2.PlaceholderText = "Gear ID 2"
		tb3.PlaceholderText = "Gear ID 3"
		tb4.PlaceholderText = "Gear ID 4"
		tb1.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 80);  tb1.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(halfW, 32)
		tb2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12 + halfW + 8, 80); tb2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(halfW, 32)
		tb3.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 116); tb3.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(halfW, 32)
		tb4.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12 + halfW + 8, 116); tb4.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(halfW, 32)
		tb2.Visible = true; tb3.Visible = true; tb4.Visible = true
		TS:Create(btnMulti, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency = 0, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}):Play()
		TS:Create(btnSingle, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 175)}):Play()
		TS:Create(giveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 158)}):Play()
		TS:Create(status, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 204)}):Play()
		TS:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, MULTI_H)}):Play()
		setStatus("Multiple gear mode (4 slots).")
	else
		tb1.PlaceholderText = "Enter Gear ID..."
		tb1.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 80); tb1.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 34)
		tb2.Visible = false; tb3.Visible = false; tb4.Visible = false
		TS:Create(btnSingle, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency = 0, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}):Play()
		TS:Create(btnMulti, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 175)}):Play()
		TS:Create(giveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 122)}):Play()
		TS:Create(status, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 166)}):Play()
		TS:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, SINGLE_H)}):Play()
		setStatus("Single gear mode.")
	end
end

btnSingle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if mode ~= "single" then setMode("single") end end)
btnMulti.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if mode ~= "multi" then setMode("multi") end end)

local function giveGear()
	local ids = {}
	for _, b in ipairs(boxes) do
		if b.Visible then
			for id in b.Text:gmatch("%d+") do ids[#ids+1] = id end
		end
	end
	if #ids == 0 then
		setStatus("Enter at least one valid Gear ID.", Color3.fromRGB(240, 120, 120))
		return
	end
	local remote = findGearRemote()
	if not remote then
		setStatus("Gear remote not found.", Color3.fromRGB(240, 120, 120))
		return
	end
	setStatus("Requesting " .. #ids .. " gear(s)...", Color3.fromRGB(220, 200, 120))
	local okCount = 0
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
		local ok = pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer("give gear", id) end)
		if ok then okCount += 1 end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	if okCount == #ids then
		setStatus("Requested " .. okCount .. " gear(s)!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 150))
	else
		setStatus("Requested " .. okCount .. "/" .. #ids .. " gear(s).", Color3.fromRGB(230, 200, 120))
	end
end

giveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(giveGear)
for _, b in ipairs(boxes) do
	b.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then giveGear() end end)
end

setMode("single")

local dragging, dragStart, startPos
header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = main.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
		end)
	end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)
